This page is the interactive version of the lesson notes (PDF). Each section
is one step of the seminar. It ends with a **Do it** task and one set of
questions. The full explanations, examples and exercises are in the notes.
You work alone.

## Key terms

{{< glossary asset-inventory licence-audit rights-clearance tasl credits-file copyright-holder work-for-hire >}}

## 26.1 Step 1: the asset inventory

- One row per asset: **file**, **type**, **where it came from**.
- Include the store page, the trailer and marketing images.

![A licence audit in five steps.](images/audit-steps.png){width=94%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
The store page and the trailer are public too: audit them.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Your inventory"}
Make an inventory of a small project: file, type, where it came from.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · The inventory"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="only the art folder|only paid assets"}
one row of the inventory
:   one asset file

a place outside the game files
:   the store page

the type of night_rain.ogg
:   sound

the type of physics.dll
:   code
:::
:::

## 26.2 Step 2–3: source and licence

- Add **source**, **licence** (exact), **proof** (page, receipt,
  contract).
- Unknown source after searching and asking: replace.

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Never write "free" or "internet" as a licence.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Find the licences"}
Add source, licence and proof to your inventory.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · Proofs"}
Choose the proof.

::: {.match extra="a screenshot of a search|a chat message"}
night_rain.ogg, CC BY 4.0
:   the saved licence page

theme.ogg by a freelancer
:   the signed contract

a sprite pack bought in a store
:   the receipt and the licence

poster_bg.jpg from an image search
:   none: replace it
:::
:::

## 26.3 Step 4: the status of each asset

- **Cleared:** allowed and credited.
- **To fix:** allowed, but a credit, notice or contract is missing.
- **Replace:** not allowed, or unknown.

![Part of the audit.](images/audit-table.png){width=94%}

{{< sim file="sims/audit-board.html" poster="sims/audit-board.png" title="Audit Board: the assets of Rooftop Rescue" height="640" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
"Nobody will notice" is not a status.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Run the audit"}
In **Audit Board**, give each asset a status and check; then mark your own
inventory.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · Statuses"}
Use Audit Board. Choose the status.

::: {.match extra="ignore|delete the game"}
CC BY sound, no credit line yet
:   to fix

CC BY-NC sticker in a game for sale
:   replace

font under the OFL, credit written
:   cleared

MIT library, notice missing
:   to fix
:::
:::

## 26.4 Step 5: fix, credit and report

- Fix yellow rows; replace red rows and audit the new assets.
- Update the **credits file** and the credits screen.
- **Audit report:** date, numbers cleared, fixed, replaced, open.

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
A replacement asset needs the same check.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Your audit report"}
Write a 5–8 line audit report and update your credits file.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 4 · The report"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="never|only once"}
when to repeat the audit
:   after every update with new assets

where the credits go
:   the credits file and the credits screen

what a red row needs
:   a replacement

what a yellow row needs
:   a fix, such as a credit
:::
:::

## Game challenge: Audit Fixes {.challenge}

Work alone. Use every section of today.

Six findings: a sound **without credit**, an **NC sticker**, an **unknown
poster**, an MIT library **without notice**, a theme **without contract**,
and an **update** with new assets.

{{< sim file="sims/audit-fixes.html" poster="sims/audit-fixes.png" title="Audit Fixes: six findings, six fixes" kind="game" height="480" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 5 · The fixes"}
Choose the fix.

::: {.match extra="make it smaller|change two notes"}
CC BY sound without a credit
:   write the TASL credit

poster from an unknown source
:   replace it

MIT library without its notice
:   add the notice

a theme paid without a contract
:   sign a written contract
:::
:::

## Summary {.summary}

- An audit starts with a complete inventory, including marketing.
- Find the source, the exact licence and the proof of each asset.
- Mark each asset cleared, to fix or replace.
- Fix, replace, update the credits, and write a report.
- Repeat the audit after each update.
